_comment: ClusterOS settings. Copy this file to ~/.clusteros/config.json, or let the
Settings tab in the app write it for you. Every key is optional — anything
missing falls back to the default shown here. Keys prefixed with _ are
ignored by the loader and exist only as documentation.
This file holds NO credentials. Node credentials live in clusters.xlsx.
_theme: "dark" or "light". Toggled live from the rail.
_refresh_time: Seconds between monitor polls. Lower = fresher, more SSH load.
_monitor_workers: Parallel status probes. Raise for large fleets, lower if the SSH server throttles.
_sftp_workers: Parallel SFTP streams during a transfer. Also caps concurrent handshakes.
_connect_retries: SSH connect attempts before a node is marked offline. Backoff doubles each try.
_banner_timeout: Seconds to wait for the SSH protocol banner. Raise on slow or loaded servers.
_cpu_alert: CPU percent above which a node tile turns red.
_ram_alert: RAM percent above which a node tile turns red.
_excel_path: Absolute path to your inventory workbook. Blank = search clusteros.py's folder, then the cwd, then ~.
_notifications: Desktop pop-ups when a node crosses an alert threshold. macOS and Linux only.
_gateway: hostname of a node to tunnel through when a target is not directly routable. Blank = auto-detect.
_auto_gateway: When a node is unreachable, automatically pick the best reachable node as a jump host.
_sim_process_pattern: Extended-regex matching YOUR long-running job processes. Each node's tile
counts matching processes alongside its Slurm jobs. Blank (the default)
_x11_forward: Add `ssh -X` when opening an interactive terminal, so remote GUI apps display locally. Needs XQuartz on macOS.
